column2:
abbreviate(v.)縮寫、縮短
abbreviation(n.)縮寫、縮寫字
be abbreviated to 縮寫為…
abbreviated form 縮寫形式
The United Nations is often abbreviated to UN in news reports.
(聯合國在新聞報導中常縮寫為UN。)
Because of the storm, the ceremony had to be abbreviated.
(由於暴風雨，典禮只好縮短進行。)

abide(v.)遵守、忍受
abiding(adj.)持久的
abide by 遵守
can't abide 無法忍受
All players must abide by the rules of the competition.
(所有選手都必須遵守比賽規則。)
She can't abide people who are rude to service staff.
(她無法忍受對服務人員無禮的人。)

aboriginal(adj./n.)原住民的、土著的、原住民
aborigine(n.)原住民
aboriginal culture 原住民文化
aboriginal people 原住民
The festival celebrates the music and dance of aboriginal culture in Taiwan.
(這個節慶慶祝台灣原住民文化的音樂與舞蹈。)
Many aboriginal languages are in danger of disappearing.
(許多原住民語言正面臨消失的危機。)

abound(v.)大量存在、充滿
abundant(adj.)豐富的
abound in/with 充滿…
rumors abound 謠言四起
Rumors abound about the singer's retirement.
(關於那位歌手退休的謠言四起。)
The coral reefs here abound with colorful fish.
(這裡的珊瑚礁有大量色彩繽紛的魚。)

abstraction(n.)抽象概念、抽象化、心不在焉
abstract(adj./n.)抽象的、摘要
abstract(v.)提取、抽象化
mathematical abstraction 數學抽象概念
in abstraction 抽象地
Justice is an abstraction that is difficult to define precisely.
(正義是一個很難精確定義的抽象概念。)
He stared out the window in a state of abstraction.
(他心不在焉地凝視著窗外。)

abundance(n.)大量、豐富
abundant(adj.)豐富的、充足的
in abundance 大量、充足
an abundance of 大量的…
Fruit grows in abundance on the island during the summer.
(這座島嶼夏天盛產水果。)
The library offers an abundance of resources for research.
(圖書館提供大量的研究資源。)

academy(n.)學院、專科學校、研究院
academic(adj.)學術的
military academy 軍校
Academia Sinica 中央研究院
He was accepted into a prestigious military academy after graduation.
(他畢業後被一所知名軍校錄取。)
She studied dance at a performing arts academy in London.
(她在倫敦一所表演藝術學院學舞。)

accessory(n./adj.)配件、飾品、從犯、附屬的
(無詞性變化)
fashion accessories 時尚配件
phone accessories 手機配件
The shop sells phone cases and other accessories.
(那間店販售手機殼和其他配件。)
A simple scarf can be the perfect accessory for a plain outfit.
(一條簡單的圍巾可以是樸素服裝的完美配件。)

acclaim(n./v.)稱讚、喝采、讚揚
acclaimed(adj.)受讚譽的
critical acclaim 評論家的讚譽
widely acclaimed 廣受讚揚
The director's latest film received wide critical acclaim.
(那位導演的新片獲得評論界廣泛讚譽。)
Her novel was acclaimed as a masterpiece of modern literature.
(她的小說被譽為現代文學的傑作。)

accordance(n.)一致、符合
accord(n./v.)一致、協議
according(adv.)按照
in accordance with 依照、根據
in accordance with the law 依法
The decision was made in accordance with school regulations.
(這項決定是依照校規做出的。)
All waste must be handled in accordance with the law.
(所有廢棄物都必須依法處理。)

accordingly(adv.)因此、相應地
according(adv.)按照
act accordingly 相應地行動
adjust accordingly 隨之調整
The weather may change quickly, so plan accordingly.
(天氣可能變化很快，所以要事先做好相應的規劃。)
Prices went up, and accordingly, sales dropped.
(價格上漲了，銷量因而下滑。)

accountable(adj.)應負責任的
accountability(n.)責任、問責
hold sb. accountable 要某人負責
be accountable for 對…負責
Politicians must be held accountable for their promises.
(政治人物必須為他們的承諾負責。)
Each team member is accountable for a part of the project.
(每位組員都要對專題中的一部分負責。)

accumulate(v.)累積、積聚
accumulation(n.)累積
accumulative(adj.)累積的
accumulate wealth 累積財富
accumulate experience 累積經驗
Dust accumulates quickly on the shelves if you don't clean them.
(如果不清理，灰塵很快就會在架子上堆積。)
She accumulated valuable experience by volunteering abroad.
(她藉由到國外當志工累積了寶貴的經驗。)

accumulation(n.)累積、積聚、堆積物
accumulate(v.)累積
accumulation of wealth 財富累積
snow accumulation 積雪
The accumulation of plastic waste in the ocean threatens marine life.
(海洋中塑膠垃圾的堆積威脅著海洋生物。)
Learning a language is a slow accumulation of small improvements.
(學習語言是一點一滴進步的緩慢累積。)

accusation(n.)指控、控告
accuse(v.)指控
make an accusation 提出指控
false accusation 誣告
He strongly denied the accusation of cheating on the exam.
(他強烈否認考試作弊的指控。)
False accusations can seriously damage a person's reputation.
(不實的指控會嚴重損害一個人的名譽。)

accustom(v.)使習慣
accustomed(adj.)習慣的
be accustomed to 習慣於
accustom oneself to 使自己習慣於
It took me weeks to accustom myself to the new time zone.
(我花了好幾週才適應新的時區。)
She is accustomed to getting up early for morning practice.
(她已經習慣早起參加晨練。)

acne(n.)粉刺、痘痘、青春痘
(無詞性變化)
suffer from acne 長痘痘
acne scars 痘疤
Many teenagers suffer from acne during puberty.
(許多青少年在青春期長痘痘。)
Washing your face gently can help prevent acne.
(溫和地洗臉有助於預防痘痘。)

acre(n.)英畝
acreage(n.)英畝數、面積
acres of land 數英畝的土地
per acre 每英畝
The farm covers more than five hundred acres of land.
(這座農場占地超過五百英畝。)
An acre is roughly equal to 4,047 square meters.
(一英畝大約等於四千零四十七平方公尺。)

adaptation(n.)適應、改編、改編作品
adapt(v.)適應、改編
adaptive(adj.)適應的
film adaptation 電影改編版
adaptation to 對…的適應
The film is an adaptation of a popular Japanese comic.
(這部電影改編自一部受歡迎的日本漫畫。)
Thick fur is an adaptation to the extreme cold of the Arctic.
(厚毛皮是對北極嚴寒的一種適應。)

addiction(n.)成癮、上癮、沉迷
addict(n./v.)成癮者、使上癮
addictive(adj.)使人上癮的
internet addiction 網路成癮
drug addiction 毒癮
Internet addiction can affect students' sleep and grades.
(網路成癮會影響學生的睡眠和成績。)
Some mobile games are designed to be highly addictive.
(有些手機遊戲被設計得非常容易讓人上癮。)

administer(v.)管理、執行、給予(藥物)
administrate(v.)管理、經營(同administer)
administration(n.)管理、行政
administer a test 舉行測驗
administer medicine 給藥
The exam will be administered by the College Entrance Examination Center.
(這項考試將由大學入學考試中心辦理。)
The nurse administered the medicine to the patient every four hours.
(護理師每四小時給病人用一次藥。)

admiral(n.)海軍上將、艦隊司令
(無詞性變化)
rear admiral 海軍少將
fleet admiral 海軍五星上將
The admiral led the fleet into the harbor.
(海軍上將率領艦隊駛入港口。)
He rose from a young sailor to an admiral over thirty years.
(他花了三十年從年輕水手晉升為海軍上將。)

adolescence(n.)青春期
adolescent(n./adj.)青少年、青春期的
during adolescence 在青春期
early adolescence 青春期早期
Many physical and emotional changes take place during adolescence.
(青春期會發生許多生理和情緒上的變化。)
Friendships formed in adolescence often last a lifetime.
(青春期結交的友誼往往維持一輩子。)

advisory(adj.)諮詢的、顧問的
advise(v.)建議
adviser(n.)顧問
advisory committee 諮詢委員會
travel advisory 旅遊警示
The government set up an advisory committee on education reform.
(政府成立了教育改革諮詢委員會。)
The weather bureau issued a heat advisory for southern Taiwan.
(氣象署對南台灣發布高溫資訊。)

aesthetic(adj.)美學的、審美的、美感的
aesthetics(n.)美學
aesthetically(adv.)美學上
aesthetic value 美學價值
aesthetically pleasing 賞心悅目的
The new library was designed with both function and aesthetic value in mind.
(新圖書館的設計兼顧了功能與美學價值。)
The garden is arranged in an aesthetically pleasing way.
(這座花園布置得賞心悅目。)

affectionate(adj.)充滿深情的、親切的
affection(n.)喜愛、感情
affectionately(adv.)親切地
affectionate hug 深情的擁抱
affectionate nickname 親暱的暱稱
My grandmother greeted me with an affectionate hug.
(奶奶給了我一個溫暖的擁抱。)
Cats can be surprisingly affectionate toward their owners.
(貓對主人可能出奇地黏人親暱。)

affiliate(n.)分支機構、附屬機構、會員
affiliate(v.)使隸屬、使加入
affiliated(adj.)附屬的、有關聯的
affiliated hospital 附屬醫院
local affiliate 地方分支機構
The TV station is a local affiliate of a national network.
(這家電視台是全國聯播網的地方分台。)
She works at a hospital affiliated with the university.
(她在一家大學附設醫院工作。)

affirm(v.)斷言、證實、肯定
affirmation(n.)斷言、肯定
affirmative(adj.)肯定的
affirm one's commitment 重申承諾
affirmative answer 肯定的回答
The president affirmed the country's commitment to democracy.
(總統重申國家對民主的承諾。)
The test results affirmed the doctor's original diagnosis.
(檢驗結果證實了醫生原先的診斷。)

airtight(adj.)密封的、不透氣的、無懈可擊的
(無詞性變化)
airtight container 密封容器
airtight alibi 無懈可擊的不在場證明
Store the cookies in an airtight container to keep them fresh.
(把餅乾存放在密封容器中以保持新鮮。)
The suspect had an airtight alibi for the night of the crime.
(嫌犯在案發當晚有無懈可擊的不在場證明。)

airway(n.)呼吸道、航線、航空公司
(無詞性變化)
clear the airway 暢通呼吸道
British Airways 英國航空
The first step in first aid is to make sure the airway is clear.
(急救的第一步是確保呼吸道暢通。)
Smoke can irritate your airways and make breathing difficult.
(煙霧會刺激呼吸道，使呼吸困難。)

algebra(n.)代數
algebraic(adj.)代數的
linear algebra 線性代數
algebra problem 代數題
Many students find algebra more challenging than arithmetic.
(許多學生覺得代數比算術更有挑戰性。)
She solved the algebra problem in just a few minutes.
(她只花幾分鐘就解出那道代數題。)

alienate(v.)使疏遠、使不友善
alienation(n.)疏遠、隔閡
alienated(adj.)被疏遠的、疏離的
alienate voters 失去選民支持
feel alienated 感到疏離
His rude comments alienated many of his old friends.
(他無禮的言論讓許多老朋友疏遠了他。)
New immigrants sometimes feel alienated in a foreign culture.
(新移民有時在異國文化中感到疏離。)

align(v.)使成一直線、使一致、結盟
alignment(n.)排成直線、結盟
align with 與…一致、與…結盟
align the text 對齊文字
Make sure the pictures are aligned before you print the poster.
(印海報前確認圖片都已對齊。)
The school's goals are closely aligned with the new curriculum.
(學校的目標與新課綱緊密一致。)

allege(v.)宣稱、聲稱(無證據地)
allegation(n.)指控、宣稱
alleged(adj.)被指控的、據稱的
allegedly(adv.)據稱
allege that 聲稱…
alleged crime 被指控的罪行
The newspaper alleged that the mayor had accepted bribes.
(報紙聲稱市長收受了賄賂。)
The alleged thief was released due to lack of evidence.
(那名涉嫌竊盜的人因證據不足而獲釋。)

alligator(n.)短吻鱷
(無詞性變化)
alligator skin 鱷魚皮
American alligator 美洲短吻鱷
Alligators are commonly found in the swamps of Florida.
(在佛羅里達的沼澤中常可以看到短吻鱷。)
The tourists watched an alligator sunbathing on the riverbank.
(觀光客看著一隻短吻鱷在河岸上曬太陽。)

altitude(n.)高度、海拔
(無詞性變化)
high altitude 高海拔
altitude sickness 高山症
The plane was flying at an altitude of 10,000 meters.
(飛機在一萬公尺的高度飛行。)
Climbers may suffer from altitude sickness on Jade Mountain.
(登山客在玉山上可能會出現高山症。)

aluminum(n.)鋁
(無詞性變化)
aluminum foil 鋁箔紙
aluminum can 鋁罐
Wrap the sweet potatoes in aluminum foil before baking them.
(烤地瓜之前先用鋁箔紙包起來。)
Aluminum cans should be put in the recycling bin.
(鋁罐應該放進資源回收桶。)

ambiguity(n.)模稜兩可、含糊不清
ambiguous(adj.)模稜兩可的
ambiguously(adv.)含糊地
avoid ambiguity 避免歧義
legal ambiguity 法律上的模糊地帶
Good writers choose their words carefully to avoid ambiguity.
(好的作者會謹慎選字以避免語意不清。)
The ambiguity in the contract led to a long legal dispute.
(合約中含糊不清之處引發了漫長的法律糾紛。)

amid(prep.)在…之中、在…期間
amidst(prep.)在…之中(較文雅)
amid concerns 在各界憂慮聲中
amid the chaos 在一片混亂中
The concert went ahead amid concerns about the coming typhoon.
(在各界對颱風的擔憂聲中，演唱會仍照常舉行。)
She remained calm amid the chaos after the earthquake.
(地震過後一片混亂中，她依然保持冷靜。)

amplify(v.)放大、擴大、詳述
amplifier(n.)擴音器
amplification(n.)放大、擴大
amplify sound 放大聲音
amplify the effect 擴大效果
The microphone amplifies the speaker's voice so everyone can hear.
(麥克風放大講者的聲音，讓大家都聽得到。)
Social media can amplify rumors within minutes.
(社群媒體能在幾分鐘內把謠言擴散開來。)

analogy(n.)類比、相似之處
analogous(adj.)類似的
draw an analogy 做類比
by analogy 用類推的方法
The teacher drew an analogy between the heart and a water pump.
(老師把心臟比作抽水機。)
By analogy, we can understand how electricity flows through a circuit.
(用類比的方法，我們可以理解電流如何在電路中流動。)

analytical(adj.)分析的、善於分析的
analyze(v.)分析
analysis(n.)分析
analytical skills 分析能力
analytical thinking 分析性思考
Studying science helps students develop strong analytical skills.
(學習科學能幫助學生培養很強的分析能力。)
She has an analytical mind and enjoys solving puzzles.
(她頭腦善於分析，喜歡解謎。)

anchor(n./v.)錨、支柱、新聞主播、停泊、使固定
anchorage(n.)停泊處
drop anchor 下錨、停泊
news anchor 新聞主播
The ship dropped anchor near the small island.
(那艘船在小島附近下錨停泊。)
She has been the evening news anchor for ten years.
(她擔任晚間新聞主播已經十年了。)

animate(v./adj.)使有生氣、製作成動畫、有生命的
animation(n.)動畫、生氣
animated(adj.)動畫的、活躍的
animated film 動畫電影
animated discussion 熱烈的討論
The students had an animated discussion about climate change.
(學生們針對氣候變遷進行了熱烈的討論。)
The studio spent three years animating the feature film.
(這家工作室花了三年製作這部動畫長片。)

annoyance(n.)惱怒、煩惱、令人煩惱的事
annoy(v.)使惱怒
annoying(adj.)令人惱怒的
to one's annoyance 令某人惱怒的是
minor annoyance 小麻煩
To my annoyance, the bus was late again this morning.
(令我惱火的是，今天早上公車又誤點了。)
The constant noise from the construction site is a great annoyance.
(工地持續的噪音是一大困擾。)

anthem(n.)國歌、讚歌、聖歌
(無詞性變化)
national anthem 國歌
sing the anthem 唱國歌
Everyone stood up when the national anthem was played.
(國歌響起時，大家都站了起來。)
The song became an anthem for a whole generation of young people.
(那首歌成了一整個世代年輕人的代表歌曲。)

antibiotic(n./adj.)抗生素、抗生的
(無詞性變化)
take antibiotics 服用抗生素
antibiotic resistance 抗藥性
The doctor prescribed antibiotics for my throat infection.
(醫生開了抗生素治療我的喉嚨感染。)
Overusing antibiotics can lead to antibiotic resistance.
(過度使用抗生素可能導致抗藥性。)

anticipation(n.)期待、預期、預料
anticipate(v.)預期、期待
in anticipation of 預料到…、期待著…
eager anticipation 熱切期待
Fans waited in eager anticipation for the band to appear on stage.
(歌迷們熱切期待樂團登台。)
Stores stocked up on water in anticipation of the typhoon.
(商店預期颱風來襲而囤積了大量飲用水。)

antonym(n.)反義詞
antonymous(adj.)反義的
the antonym of 某字的反義詞
synonyms and antonyms 同義詞與反義詞
The antonym of 'generous' is 'stingy'.
(generous的反義詞是stingy。)
Learning synonyms and antonyms helps expand your vocabulary.
(學習同義詞和反義詞有助於擴充字彙量。)

applaud(v.)鼓掌、讚許
applause(n.)掌聲
applaud loudly 熱烈鼓掌
applaud sb. for 為了…讚揚某人
The audience applauded loudly at the end of the performance.
(表演結束時觀眾熱烈鼓掌。)
We applaud her for her courage to speak out.
(我們讚揚她勇於發聲的勇氣。)

applicable(adj.)適用的、可應用的
apply(v.)應用、適用
applicability(n.)適用性
applicable to 適用於
where applicable 在適用的情況下
These rules are applicable to all students in the school.
(這些規定適用於全校所有學生。)
Please fill in your phone number where applicable.
(如適用，請填寫你的電話號碼。)

apprentice(n.)學徒、見習生
apprenticeship(n.)學徒期、學徒身分
apprentice chef 學徒廚師
serve an apprenticeship 當學徒
He worked as an apprentice chef in a famous restaurant.
(他在一家知名餐廳擔任學徒廚師。)
She served a three-year apprenticeship before opening her own shop.
(她當了三年學徒才開了自己的店。)

approximate(adj./v.)大約的、近似的、接近
approximately(adv.)大約
approximation(n.)近似值
approximate cost 大約的費用
approximate number 大概的數目
The approximate cost of the school trip is 3,000 dollars.
(校外教學的費用大約是三千元。)
The final result closely approximates our original estimate.
(最後的結果非常接近我們原先的估計。)

archaeology(n.)考古學
archaeologist(n.)考古學家
archaeological(adj.)考古學的
marine archaeology 水下考古學
archaeological site 考古遺址
She became interested in archaeology after visiting Egypt.
(她去過埃及後對考古學產生了興趣。)
Archaeologists discovered pottery from 4,000 years ago at the site.
(考古學家在遺址中發現了四千年前的陶器。)

archive(n./v.)檔案、檔案館、存檔
archival(adj.)檔案的
national archives 國家檔案館
archive files 將檔案歸檔
The old photographs are kept in the city archives.
(那些老照片被保存在市立檔案館裡。)
